title: A conversation with many agents needs to show what changed (2026-10-26)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Here is a critical issue to add to the top of our agent assisted editor pipeline.

I need to be able to maintain a conversation with multiple agents. They need to be able to see what has changed in order to be most useful and not distract with details in areas that are not the current focus.

We have a pr for the attention data already, that's also part of the same remedy

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-26; recorded verbatim. Said straight after Claude Code reported that agents cannot ask an SRS repository for the latest or changed notes (find ranks by match or id, not date; no changed-since filter; notes show no created or updated time). 'The attention data' PR is srs-rust#1472 (srs-rust#1344, remedy 800f223f).
